chapter.verse: Gentailte in Pasian’ thu a san’ uh Judah gamah a om sawltakte leh u leh naute in a za uh hi.
Piter in Jerusalem khua-ah a paitoh ciangin vunatte in,
“Nang in vunat lote kiangah pai-in amau tawh an na ne khawm hi,” ci-in a mawhsak uh hi.
Piter in a kizom a kizomin a gen-inah:
“Keimah in Joppa khua sungah thu ka ngen hi. Ka nget lai takin mang sungah vantung panin kiu li tawh a kikhaisuk puanza tawh kibang na khat ka muh leh, keima kiangah hong tungsuk hi.
Hih puan a tel takpi-in en a, ka ngaihsut lai takin leitungah khe li nei ganhingte tawh, gamsate tawh, bokvak ganhingte tawh, vana vasate tawh ka mu hi.
‘Piter aw, tho in, go in la, ne in,’ hong ci aw khat ka za hi.
Keimah in, ‘Topa aw, tua bang hi thei lo hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, a nin a siangtho lote keima kam sungah khatvei beek a tum ngei kei hi,’ ka ci hi.
‘Pasian in a sian’ thosakte a siangtho lo na sa kei in,’ ci-in vantung panin nihvei aw in hong ci hi.
Tua mah bangin thumvei a hih khit ciangin tua khempeuh vantungah a kaito kik hi.
Kaisaria khua pan ka kiangah hong sawl mi thum in thakhatin ka omna inn kiangah a ding uh hi.
Kha Siangtho in, ‘Na lung himawh sak loin amau tawh na paikhawm in,’ hong ci hi. Hih unau gukte in zong keimah tawh a paikhawm uh a, tua mipa’ innah a tum uh hi.
Amah in, ‘Vantungmi khat in ka inn sungah ding-a om ka mu a, ‘Joppa khua-ah a min thak Piter kici Simon sam dingin sawl in.
Tua pa in nangmah leh na innkuanpihte gupna na ngah nadingun hong hilh ding hi,’ hong ci hi’ ci-in hong gen hi.
Keimah in thuhilh ka kipat lai takin, amasa-a eite tungah Kha Siangtho a hong tun’ mah bangin amaute tungah a tung hi.
‘Johan in tui sungah hong baptaiz hangin note in Kha Siangtho sungah na kibaptaiz ding uh hi,’ ci-in Topa’ thugenna ka phawk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in Topa Zeisu Khazih’ thu i up ciangin Pasian in thupha hong piak mah bangin Pasian in tuate a piak leh, Pasian a nial dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?” ci-in Piter in a gen hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin nial loin, “Pasian in Gentailte zong a nuntak nadingin kisikkikna thu a pia hi,” ci-in Pasian a phat uh hi.
Stefen tungah kibawlsiatna thu hangin a kithehthang mite in Foenisia gam leh Saipras gam leh Antiok khua dongin a pai uh a, Judah mite kiang bekah Pasian’ thu a hilh uh hi.
Ahih hangin Saipras mi leh Sairin mi kimkhat in Antiok khuapi-ah a tun’ uh ciangin Topa Zeisu’ Lungdamna Thu Grik mite kiangah zong a hilh uh hi.
Pasian’ khut in amaute tawh omkhawm a, thu-um mi tampi in Pasian kiangah a kihei uh hi.
Tua mite thute Jerusalem khua pawlpite in a zak uh ciangin Antiok khua-ah Barnabas a sawl uh hi.
Barnabas a tun’ ciangin Pasian’ hehpihna thupha a muh ciangin a lungdamin amaute in a lungsim tawh Pasian beel dingin mi khempeuh a hansuah hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Barnabas in mipha hi a, Kha Siangtho leh thu-upna tawh dim a, Topa tawh mi tampi a kibehlap hi.
Tua khit ciangin Saul a zong dingin Barnabas paikhia a, Tarsas khua a tung hi.
A muh ciangin Antiok khua-ah a paipih hi. Tuate in pawlpi tawh kum khat omkhawm uh a, mi tampi kiangah thu a hilh uh hi. Zeisu’ nungzuite in Antiok khua-ah Christian a kici masa bel hi.
Tua lai takin Jerusalem khua panin Antiok khua-ah Pasian’ kamsangte hong tung uh hi.
Tuate lakah Agabas kici khat in ding a, “Gam khempeuh sungah kial hong tung ding hi,” ci-in Kha Siangtho tawh a hilh hi. Tua kialpi in kumpipa Klaudias a man’ lai-in a hong tung hi.
Nungzuite in a hih theih zah ciat bangun Judah gamah a om u leh naute kiangah huhna sum khak dingin a vaihawm uh hi.
Tua mah bangin a bawl uh a, upate kiangah Barnabas leh Saul te’ khut tawh a khak uh hi.
